lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica

lines.value: A medicine is inscribed in the Registro de Especialidades Medicinales (REM), and ANMAT certifies the inscription with a certificate number, holder and validity period.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica

lines.value: GTIN plus serial number (Sistema Nacional de Trazabilidad)

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: Administración Nacional de Medicamentos, Alimentos y Tecnología Médica

lines.value: Under the national traceability system the pack carries a GS1 GTIN and a serial of up to 20 case-sensitive alphanumeric characters (a 20-character serial may not start with 779), on a linear barcode, DataMatrix, RFID or dual carrier; DataMatrix or RFID must also hold lot and expiry, shown in readable form too; registration certificate holders apply it, one carrier per pack.
